<p class="bms-glossary-term-name">Roll a Prime</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-aliases"><strong>Also called:</strong> <span id="alias-roll-a-prime-forward">Roll a Prime Forward</span>, <span id="alias-walk-a-prime">Walk a Prime</span></p>
